description: For repo owners: authenticate to TaskBounty via a browser device flow. No API key required up front. Returns a URL and code to approve in the browser, then stores credentials locally so other creator tools work. If already authenticated, it reports that and does nothing. Run this once before autopilot_enable or post_from_issue.

client_name.description: Optional label shown on the approval screen (e.g. 'Cursor on my laptop').

name: taskbounty_login
